definition: To succeed in doing something through effort or skill.

examples.sentence: She worked hard to achieve her goals.

definition: A condition or fact that helps you succeed.

examples.sentence: Knowing English is a great advantage when you travel.
examples.translation: Seyahat ederken İngilizce bilmek büyük bir avantajdır.

definition: To give permission for something to happen.

examples.sentence: Our teacher allows us to use dictionaries in class.
examples.translation: Öğretmenimiz sınıfta sözlük kullanmamıza izin veriyor.

definition: Very old; belonging to a time long ago.

examples.sentence: They visited an ancient castle on their school trip.
examples.translation: Okul gezisinde antik bir kaleyi ziyaret ettiler.

definition: The way someone or something looks.

examples.sentence: First impressions are often based on appearance.
examples.translation: İlk izlenimler genellikle dış görünüşe dayanır.

definition: To disagree with someone in words, often angrily.

examples.sentence: They often argue about which football team is better.
examples.translation: Hangi futbol takımının daha iyi olduğu konusunda sık sık tartışıyorlar.

definition: To plan or organize something.

examples.sentence: We arranged a meeting with our English teacher.

definition: To help someone do something.

examples.sentence: Volunteers assist elderly people in our neighborhood.
examples.translation: Gönüllüler mahallemizde yaşlı insanlara yardım ediyor.

definition: Careful thought or interest in something.

examples.sentence: The students listened with great attention.

definition: To stay away from something.

examples.sentence: He avoids junk food to stay healthy.
examples.translation: Sağlıklı kalmak için abur cuburdan uzak duruyor.

definition: Forming the main or simplest part of something.

examples.sentence: This course teaches the basic rules of English grammar.
examples.translation: Bu kurs İngilizce dil bilgisinin temel kurallarını öğretiyor.

definition: To act in a particular way.

examples.sentence: Children should behave politely at school.

definition: Something good or helpful that you get from an action.

examples.sentence: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
examples.translation: Düzenli egzersizin sağlığa birçok faydası vardır.

definition: To take something from someone and return it later.

examples.sentence: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.translation: Kalemini bir dakikalığına ödünç alabilir miyim?

definition: Not afraid of danger or pain.

examples.sentence: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.

definition: Peaceful and without worry.

examples.sentence: Stay calm and focus on the exam questions.
examples.translation: Sakin ol ve sınav sorularına odaklan.

definition: Something that makes an event happen.

examples.sentence: Smoking is a major cause of lung disease.
examples.translation: Sigara, akciğer hastalığının önemli bir nedenidir.

definition: To do something special to show that an event is important.

examples.sentence: We celebrated our graduation with a small party.

definition: A period of one hundred years.

examples.sentence: The museum has objects from the nineteenth century.
examples.translation: Müzede on dokuzuncu yüzyıldan kalma eşyalar var.

definition: Sure about something; or particular but not named.

examples.sentence: Are you certain about the answer?

definition: Something difficult that tests your ability.

examples.sentence: Learning a new language is a real challenge.
examples.translation: Yeni bir dil öğrenmek gerçek bir zorluktur.

definition: Something you choose from different possibilities.

examples.sentence: She made the right choice by studying abroad.
examples.translation: Yurt dışında okuyarak doğru seçimi yaptı.

definition: The usual weather conditions of an area over a long time.

examples.sentence: The Mediterranean climate is warm and sunny.

definition: Happening every day.

examples.sentence: Reading for twenty minutes daily improves your vocabulary.
examples.translation: Her gün yirmi dakika okumak kelime bilgini geliştirir.

definition: Physical harm that makes something less valuable or useful.

examples.sentence: The storm damaged many houses in the village.
examples.translation: Fırtına köyde birçok eve zarar verdi.

definition: A formal discussion in which people express different opinions.

examples.sentence: Our class held a debate on social media.
examples.translation: Sınıfımız sosyal medya hakkında bir münazara düzenledi.

definition: To choose something after thinking about it.

examples.sentence: They decided to spend their holiday in Antalya.

definition: To need something or someone in order to exist or succeed.

examples.sentence: Plants depend on sunlight to grow.
examples.translation: Bitkiler büyümek için güneş ışığına ihtiyaç duyar.

definition: To say what someone or something is like.

examples.sentence: Can you describe your best friend?
examples.translation: En iyi arkadaşını tarif edebilir misin?

definition: To grow gradually or become better.

examples.sentence: This app helps students develop their reading skills.
examples.translation: Bu uygulama öğrencilerin okuma becerilerini geliştirmesine yardımcı oluyor.

definition: To receive money for work you do.

examples.sentence: He earns extra money by tutoring younger students.
examples.translation: Küçük öğrencilere özel ders vererek ekstra para kazanıyor.

definition: Learning or teaching in a school or college.

examples.sentence: Education is the key to a better future.
examples.translation: Eğitim, daha iyi bir geleceğin anahtarıdır.

definition: A change caused by an action.

examples.sentence: Too much screen time has negative effects on sleep.
examples.translation: Aşırı ekran süresi uykuyu olumsuz etkiler.

definition: Physical or mental energy used to do something.

examples.sentence: With enough effort, anyone can learn English.

definition: To give someone confidence to do something.

examples.sentence: Our coach encourages us to never give up.
examples.translation: Antrenörümüz bizi asla vazgeçmemeye teşvik ediyor.

definition: The power to do work or be active.

examples.sentence: We should use renewable energy sources like solar power.
examples.translation: Güneş enerjisi gibi yenilenebilir enerji kaynakları kullanmalıyız.

definition: The natural world around us, including air, water and land.

examples.sentence: We must protect the environment for future generations.

definition: To get away from a place or situation.

examples.sentence: They escaped from the crowded city for the weekend.
examples.translation: Hafta sonu için kalabalık şehirden kaçtılar.

definition: Knowledge or skill gained from doing something.

examples.sentence: Traveling alone was an unforgettable experience.
examples.translation: Yalnız seyahat etmek unutulmaz bir deneyimdi.

definition: Lack of success in doing something.

examples.sentence: Don't be afraid of failure; it teaches valuable lessons.
examples.translation: Başarısızlıktan korkma; o değerli dersler öğretir.

definition: Treating everyone equally.

examples.sentence: The referee made a fair decision.

definition: Known to you because you have seen it before.

examples.sentence: This song sounds familiar to me.

definition: Popular styles of clothes at a particular time.

examples.sentence: Istanbul hosts an international fashion week every year.
examples.translation: İstanbul her yıl uluslararası bir moda haftasına ev sahipliği yapıyor.

definition: A kind act you do for someone.

examples.sentence: Could you do me a favor and lend me your notes?
examples.translation: Bana bir iyilik yapıp notlarını ödünç verir misin?

definition: An unpleasant feeling caused by danger.

examples.sentence: She overcame her fear of speaking in public.

definition: To get something useful or valuable.

examples.sentence: You can gain a lot from reading books.

definition: To come together or bring things together.

examples.sentence: The family gathered for dinner on Sunday.
examples.translation: Aile pazar günü akşam yemeği için bir araya geldi.

definition: Willing to give more than expected.

examples.sentence: Our neighbors are very generous people.

definition: Kind and calm, not rough.

examples.sentence: The gentle teacher never raises her voice.

definition: Something you give to someone willingly.

examples.sentence: She received many gifts on her birthday.

definition: Something you do regularly, often without thinking.

examples.sentence: Reading before bed is a healthy habit.
examples.translation: Yatmadan önce okumak sağlıklı bir alışkanlıktır.

definition: Damage or injury to a person or thing.

examples.sentence: Smoking harms your lungs.

definition: Truthful and sincere.

examples.sentence: An honest person always tells the truth.
examples.translation: Dürüst bir insan her zaman doğruyu söyler.

definition: A feeling that something good will happen.

examples.sentence: We hope to visit London next summer.
examples.translation: Gelecek yaz Londra'yı ziyaret etmeyi umuyoruz.

definition: Extremely large in size or amount.

examples.sentence: They live in a huge apartment near the park.
examples.translation: Parkın yanında kocaman bir dairede yaşıyorlar.

definition: To pay no attention to something.

examples.sentence: You should ignore negative comments and keep going.
examples.translation: Olumsuz yorumları görmezden gelip devam etmelisin.

definition: To form a picture in your mind.

examples.sentence: Imagine a world without the internet.

definition: To make something better.

examples.sentence: Practicing every day will improve your speaking.
examples.translation: Her gün pratik yapmak konuşmanı geliştirecek.

definition: To contain something as a part.

examples.sentence: The price includes breakfast and dinner.
examples.translation: Fiyata kahvaltı ve akşam yemeği dahil.

definition: Free from outside control; able to do things alone.

examples.sentence: University life makes students more independent.
examples.translation: Üniversite hayatı öğrencileri daha bağımsız yapar.

definition: To become a member of a group.

examples.sentence: She joined the school basketball team.

definition: Traveling from one place to another.

examples.sentence: The journey from Ankara to Izmir takes six hours by bus.
examples.translation: Ankara'dan İzmir'e yolculuk otobüsle altı saat sürer.

definition: Very interested or eager.

examples.sentence: He is keen on learning Spanish.

definition: Information and understanding about a subject.

examples.sentence: Reading books increases your general knowledge.

definition: Not having enough of something.

examples.sentence: Lack of sleep makes it hard to concentrate.

definition: The natural appearance of an area of land.

examples.sentence: The Black Sea region has a beautiful green landscape.
examples.translation: Karadeniz Bölgesi güzel yeşil bir manzaraya sahiptir.

definition: The sound of laughing.

examples.sentence: Their laughter filled the whole classroom.

definition: To start something new.

examples.sentence: The school launched a new reading project.
examples.translation: Okul yeni bir okuma projesi başlattı.

definition: To give something to someone for a short time.

examples.sentence: I lent my bike to my cousin.

definition: To succeed in doing something difficult.

examples.sentence: She managed to finish the project on time.

definition: The way something is done.

examples.sentence: He answered in a polite manner.

definition: To become husband and wife.

examples.sentence: They married in a small ceremony.

definition: A competition between teams or players.

examples.sentence: Our team won the football match 2-0.

definition: Something you are talking about; to be important.

examples.sentence: It doesn't matter if you make mistakes.

definition: Small in width.

examples.sentence: The bus passed through a narrow street.

definition: A large group of people living in one country.

examples.sentence: Athletes from many nations joined the games.

definition: Belonging to a place by birth.

examples.sentence: Turkish is my native language.

definition: To follow rules or orders.

examples.sentence: Drivers must obey traffic rules.

definition: To watch something carefully.

examples.sentence: Students observed birds in the school garden.

definition: To get something, especially with effort.

examples.sentence: He obtained a scholarship to study abroad.
examples.translation: Yurt dışında okumak için burs elde etti.

definition: To say you will give or do something.

examples.sentence: She offered to help me with math.
examples.translation: Bana matematik konusunda yardım etmeyi teklif etti.

definition: A chance to do something.

examples.sentence: This exchange program is a great opportunity.
examples.translation: Bu değişim programı harika bir fırsat.

definition: An unpleasant feeling in your body when you are hurt.

examples.sentence: He felt a sharp pain in his knee.

definition: To take part in an activity.

examples.sentence: Everyone should participate in class discussions.

definition: Able to wait calmly; also a person receiving medical care.

examples.sentence: Be patient; learning takes time.

definition: A time without war or noise.

examples.sentence: Everyone wants to live in peace.

definition: To do something in front of people, like singing or acting.

examples.sentence: The choir will perform at the school festival.

definition: How good or bad something is.

examples.sentence: This brand is famous for its high quality.

definition: Not common or usual.

examples.sentence: Snow is rare in Antalya.

definition: To understand something suddenly.

examples.sentence: I realized my mistake after the exam.

definition: To get something given to you.

examples.sentence: She received a letter from her pen pal.

definition: To make something smaller or less.

examples.sentence: We should reduce plastic use to protect nature.
examples.translation: Doğayı korumak için plastik kullanımını azaltmalıyız.

definition: To say no to something.

examples.sentence: He refused the offer politely.

definition: Careful study to learn new facts.

examples.sentence: Scientists do research on clean energy.
examples.translation: Bilim insanları temiz enerji üzerine araştırma yapıyor.

definition: Something you must do as part of your duty.

examples.sentence: Feeding the cat is my responsibility.

definition: To keep someone safe or keep money for later.

examples.sentence: Seatbelts save lives every day.
examples.translation: Emniyet kemerleri her gün hayat kurtarır.

definition: Something you do not tell others.

examples.sentence: Can you keep a secret?

definition: The ability to do something well.

examples.sentence: Communication is an important life skill.

definition: People living together in a community.

examples.sentence: Schools prepare young people for society.

definition: To find an answer to a problem.

examples.sentence: Try to solve the puzzle by yourself.

definition: To offer an idea for someone to consider.

examples.sentence: I suggest studying a little every day.

definition: To help someone or something succeed.

examples.sentence: Our fans always support our team.

definition: Something unexpected.

examples.sentence: The party was a complete surprise for him.
examples.translation: Parti onun için tam bir sürprizdi.

definition: A natural ability to do something well.

examples.sentence: She has a real talent for music.
examples.translation: Müziğe karşı gerçek bir yeteneği var.

definition: A piece of work you have to do.

examples.sentence: Our first task is to read the text.

definition: A group of people working together.

examples.sentence: Our volleyball team won the tournament.

definition: The subject of a discussion or text.

examples.sentence: Today's topic is healthy eating.

definition: The only one of its kind.

examples.sentence: Every snowflake has a unique shape.
examples.translation: Her kar tanesinin eşsiz bir şekli vardır.

definition: To join together for a common purpose.

examples.sentence: Sports unite people from different cultures.

definition: Helpful for doing something.

examples.sentence: Dictionaries are very useful for learners.

definition: Worth a lot of money or very important.

examples.sentence: Time is our most valuable resource.

definition: Of different kinds.

examples.sentence: The festival offers various activities.

definition: A person who works without pay to help others.

examples.sentence: She volunteers at an animal shelter.

definition: Using more of something than needed.

examples.sentence: Don't waste water while brushing your teeth.

definition: A large amount of money or valuable things.

examples.sentence: Health is more important than wealth.

definition: The condition of the air outside, like rain or sun.

examples.sentence: The weather is perfect for a picnic.

definition: Complete; all of something.

examples.sentence: She read the whole book in two days.

definition: The time of life when you are young.

examples.sentence: Sports play a big role in the lives of the youth.
examples.translation: Spor, gençlerin hayatında büyük rol oynar.
